audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Swain/Skill/Swain; content win[] reads Karma x5 then Swain at first item then Karma; and the content layer's own whys contradict its chart — whys[4] describes Swain's ultimate flipping fights on a row marked Karma, while whys[5] says Karma out-scales his item spike on a row marked Swain.
audit.why: The kit settles it. Demonic Ascension is the level-6 unlock: a flat 120s drain form that persists as long as he drains champions. Swain has no separate first-item-only spike of that size, while Karma's Blackfire Torch window lands there. So Swain owns row 4 and Karma owns row 5.
audit.corrected: Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Swain/Karma/Karma across both layers: phases[0..3].side to Karma (win[] already Karma), win[4] to Swain (phases[4] already Swain), phases[5].side to Karma paired with win[5] to Karma, phases[6].side to Karma (win[6] already Karma).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why describes Karma's Mantra rank on the row that belongs to Swain's ultimate.
audit.why: Karma gains no new ultimate at 6; Swain gains an indefinite drain form on a flat 120s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Demonic Ascension's 120s cooldown and its sustain condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit, and nothing anywhere states how Nevermove actually works. The content layer also names two abilities Swain does not have — "Decrepit/Torment" poke and a "Cross the boundary root" — and attributes the root to his W.
audit.why: Riot's text: Nevermove (E) launches a wave forward, then it returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits — the root is on the return, not the throw, and it is E, not W. Vision of Empire (W) is the 22/21/20/19/18s revealing slow. Death's Hand (Q) reaches 750 against your 950. Ravenous Flock (P) turns chip damage into Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently raise his maximum health, which is the real reason to buy Grievous Wounds here.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries R flat 120s, E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10 at 850 and W 22s; the return-wave root is stated in dosFull[0].d; the fabricated names are replaced with Death's Hand and Nevermove.

audit.whatIsWrong: The anti-heal line exists in report[8] but nothing explains why raw resistances are the wrong answer.
audit.why: Ravenous Flock's healing and permanent max-health growth scale off damage he deals, so stacking resistances does not stop the sustain — Grievous Wounds does.

edits.after: - Demonic Ascension: a flat 120s drain form that lasts as long as he keeps draining champions — leave the radius, do not out-damage it. - Nevermove is 12s at rank 1, 850 range, and roots on the return, not the throw. - Vision of Empire is 22s.

notes: IMPORTANT — read this one. The chart here was internally contradictory in three directions: the full layer, the content win[] row, and the content whys[] all disagreed about rows 4 and 5. content win[4] said Karma while whys[4] described Swain's ultimate flipping fights; content win[5] said Swain while whys[5] said Karma out-scales his item spike. I resolved it from the kit — Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s level-6 unlock and Swain has no comparable first-item spike — so the chart now reads Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Swain/Karma/Karma on both layers, with each row's why already matching. That means rows 4 and 5 now DISAGREE WITH THE PACKET levelChart, which has them the other way round (Karma at 6, Swain at first item). I judged the packet to have the two rows transposed; confidence Medium, so if the packet is treated as authoritative this pair should be reverted together, not one at a time. All chart edits are proposed as one atomic group with paired full/content rows. Ratings left untouched — could not determine whether phases[N].rating is owner-favourability or matchup severity, so phases[4] keeps 7/10 and phases[6] keeps 7/10 under a now-Karma row 6. Three fabricated Swain ability names removed from the content layer: "Decrepit"/"Torment" poke (really Death's Hand) and "Cross the boundary root" (really Nevermove); the content layer also attributed the root to W when it is E. Content spikes[0].text also told a dashless Karma to "keep dashing forward" — replaced.
